description: Read-only state of the running system for the assistant (v2 P1): engine health, the machine and build environment, one composite snapshot, the audio device.

commands.name: system.health
commands.title: Read the engine health
commands.description: The raw GET /health of the synthesis backend: status, lifecycle, audio driver + fallback, audio watchdog, output_scale state, mode_layout, clipping / peak_level (above full scale = hard clipping, the output is not limited), gate_trip_count, cooperative_launch, listen_mode, single_deck_matrix. The per-turn context digest summarises it; read it whole when the digest is not enough.

commands.name: system.environment
commands.title: Read the machine and build environment
commands.description: GPU (name, VRAM, driver, the driver CUDA version), the engine build the backend runs (pianoidCuda release / debug variant, module build time, installed Pianoid / pianoidCuda package versions), the four repos (branch, short SHA, dirty), Python, OS, the backend pid / port, the audio output map (PIANOID_AUDIO_OUTPUT_MAP: engine channel k plays on ASIO device output map[k]; unset = identity) and the allow-listed PIANOID_* variables. Never credentials or PATH; paths outside the repos read "<set: outside the repos>".

commands.name: system.snapshot
commands.title: Read the full state snapshot
commands.description: One composite read: GET /health + GET /load_settings + the environment (system.environment) + a fingerprint (GPU, build variant, repo SHAs, output map) + the active preset summary (preset.summary). The first read of a "full state" question or a bug analysis.

commands.name: audio.devices
commands.title: Read the ASIO audio device
commands.description: The ASIO host device as the engine sees it: driver, sample rate, buffer, latencies, input / output channel lists. Read only; the measurement session (POST /audio/session) is not exposed.
